text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) (No. 7) 2020.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh mulai 22 Disember 2020

hingga 31 Disember 2020.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Daging kambing tempatan bertulang

2. Daging kambing biri-biri import bertulang

3. Ayam belanda import

4. Tomato

5. Lobak merah

6. Kepak ayam

7. Lada benggala hijau

8. Kubis bulat import (Indonesia dan China, tidak termasuk kubis Beijing)

9. Cili merah

10. Babi hidup

11. Daging babi (perut)

12. Daging babi (daging dan lemak)

Dibuat 15 Disember 2020

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/XII]

 DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

 Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri

 dan Hal Ehwal Pengguna

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 7) ORDER 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the Control of Supplies Act 1961

[Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 7) Order 2020.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles

for the period from 22 December 2020 to 31 December 2020.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Local bone-in mutton

2. Imported bone-in mutton

3. Imported turkey

4. Tomato

5. Carrot

6. Chicken wing

7. Green capsicum

8. Imported round cabbage (Indonesia and China, not including Beijing

cabbage)

9. Red chili

10. Live pig

11. Pork (belly)

12. Pork (lean and fat)
